capabilities: Lock selected text or the current paragraph
Unlock one passage or all passages in a file
Write lock markers into the Markdown source as hidden comments
Copy AI instruction text to the clipboard
Reject Claude Code edits that would change locked passages
disambiguation: Not encryption or password protection; it only adds Markdown comment markers and asks AI assistants to respect them.
extras: The optional Claude Code hook only covers Claude's file-editing tools; edits made through shell commands or by other assistants rely on the pasted instructions alone. README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
motivation: When you revise a draft back and forth with an AI assistant, passages you've already polished keep getting "improved" again.
problem: Passages already polished during back-and-forth revision with an AI assistant keep getting rewritten again.

relations.evidence: If a selection cuts through a CriticMarkup comment, such as the ones the Review Comments plugin creates

summary: Locks selected passages with hidden Markdown comment markers and a green highlight so AI assistants editing the note leave them unchanged.
